name: Rede D'Or São Luiz S.A.
summary: Rede D'Or São Luiz S.A. engages in the provision of hospital services in Brazil. The company provides assistance and hospitality concept services; and supplementary services, such as blood bank, dialysis, and outpatient clinics with various specialties. It also offers health insurance and plan, as well as dental plans for small, medium, and large-sized companies; individual plans; individual and group life, travel, credit life, endowment, as well as personal, individual, and group accident insurance products; and pension risk.
